titles.romaji: Buddy Complex Kanketsu-hen - Ano Sora ni Kaeru Mirai de
titles.english: Buddy Complex: Into the Skies of Tomorrow
titles.native: バディ・コンプレックス 完結編 ―あの空に還る未来で―

description:
The 13th episode of the Buddy Complex anime ended on Sunday with a "To be continued" message, and the official Twitter account and website for the anime confirmed that the series will still continue.

(Source: Anime News Network)
